scheme_name: Financial Assistance For The Marriage Of Daughters Of Poor Widows And Orphan Girls
other_conditions: Minimum 5 years residence in Delhi before application
Applicant must have an Aadhaar number
Applicant must have a single‑operated Aadhaar‑linked bank account in the NCT of Delhi
Applicant must not be receiving any assistance from the discretionary fund of the Lt. Governor or Chief Minister of Delhi for the same purpose
The girl whose marriage is to be solemnized must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
Application must be submitted within 60 days before or after the marriage date
Financial assistance is limited to up to two daughters only
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹30,000 per daughter, for up to two daughters.
